name: Speak text
description: Synthesises speech from text and stores it as an audio file, by default Ogg/Opus (the format of a voice note) in the caller's private DLFS speech drive. Returns {ref, mediaType, size, fileName, format, voice, model, engine}; the ref can be sent as a Telegram voice note.

voice.description: Voice name; defaults to the venue's configured voice.

model.description: Speech model; defaults to the venue's configured model.

format.description: Audio format; opus is Ogg/Opus, as voice notes are.

instructions.description: Optional guidance on tone or delivery, for models that take it.

destination.description: Directory to store the audio in, written with the caller's authority; defaults to the caller's private dlfs/speech/ drive.

fileName.description: A safe single filename; otherwise one is generated. Nothing is overwritten.

apiKey.description: Optional s/NAME reference to the caller's own key; by default the operator's key, else the caller's s/OPENAI_API_KEY, else none.
